name: ITO Etchant (HNO3 Base)
description: ITO Etchant (HNO3 Base) is a wet etching formulation based on ferric chloride and nitric acid for patterning Indium Tin Oxide (ITO) transparent conductive oxide layers. This nitric acid-based variant provides different etch characteristics compared to HCl-based formulations, offering alternative selectivity and surface finish properties for specific FPD and LED manufacturing processes. The combination of ferric chloride as the oxidant with nitric acid provides effective ITO dissolution while maintaining good process control. This formulation is particularly suited for applications where chloride residue must be minimized or where specific etch profile characteristics are required.
physicalProperties: Appearance: yellow to brown liquid; Density: ~1.2 g/cm³; pH: <1; Boiling Point: >100 °C
